about: How each alignment question (public/questions.json) finds its candidate bills in the bill index (scripts/question-bills.mjs): any = phrases (in a title or short title, or in the summary of a bill with one of the subjects), subjects = Congress.gov legislative subjects or policy areas, not = phrases that rule a bill out. Candidates are coded by hand in data/question-bills.json. Batch 1: the questions that take over today's coded issues, and the most-voted topics.
